description: Probe the embedding dimension of a model. Returns immediately with job_id and status queued; work runs on the plugin worker.
embedding_description: Queue an embedding dimension probe for the optional model or configured default. Returns job_id and status queued before the HTTP probe runs. Retrieve service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; job.result contains the original dimension and model response, and failures also retain job.error.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job handle with job_id and status; the final response is stored in job.result.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain this exact job_id. Schedule job_service::get_job while queued or processing; inspect terminal result or error before using the final data. Do not repeat a write because a poll is delayed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves the vector dimension for an embedding model
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ConnectionError: API endpoint not reachable. ModelError: Model not available or not found.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For connection errors: verify the embedding service is running. For model errors: check model name or try listing available models.
